The central hoist and faction focal point materially diverge from the approved target; do not promote v001.
incumbent_comparison: First candidate. The close view has plausible timber framing and differentiated sheets, but the 64-inch capture loses the approved wide gantry read and the 330-inch room capture is inconclusive.
next_action_hypothesis: Keep the approved target and make a substantial target-faithful geometry correction: remove intermediate front supports, enlarge the fixed side panels, simplify the central rope block and hook, and strengthen the one-bay silhouette. Compare again at the same 64-inch camera.

observations.art_direction_fit: Timber and reclaimed sheet materials suggest Scavenger construction, but the centered dark hoist mechanism and stall-like layout drift from the approved direction.
observations.close_up_quality: The close render has plausible perimeter supports and layered roof sheets, but the loading bay is less open and less target-faithful than the approved image.
observations.gameplay_readability: Luna scores 2/5. At the identical 64-inch camera, the central loading path, paired appliance slabs and centered hand hoist are not the first read.
observations.geometric_detail: The close view shows layered roof sheets, posts, door panels and side storage, but the center hoist and unloading route lose definition in the gameplay frame.
observations.material_realism: Timber and sheet surfaces separate under production lighting; the dark metal and gold-toned hoist details create an unintended Clockwork cue.
observations.proportion: The major structure fits the 23.63 x 12.18 x 18.72 inch technical bounds, but the side panels are too small relative to the opening for a clear gameplay read.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot validates 23.63 x 12.18 x 18.72 inches against the 24 x 13 x 20 inch envelope; the 330-inch room view is too distant to show an asset-level improvement.
observations.semantic_recognizability: At 64 inches, side roof planes and a dark central mechanism dominate; the intended supply depot and open loading face are weak.
observations.silhouette_quality: The candidate reads as adjacent small roofed stalls rather than the approved broad, asymmetric gantry bay.
observations.surface_variation: The close view shows broad roof and wood variation, while those distinctions are subdued in the settlement capture.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 imported and rendered the candidate through a review-only registry; validation passed with 10 meshes, 10 surfaces and 60,492 triangles.

close_inspection.evidence: The close render has supported perimeter framing, but the approved wide opening, prominent paired panels and central hoist do not all read clearly.

edge_treatment.evidence: Roof sheets and door slabs have softened edges in the close production render.

hardware.evidence: Door straps are present, but the central dark pulley shapes read as a Clockwork mechanism rather than a simple hand hoist.

joins.evidence: Perimeter roof supports are visible, but the central hoist load path and its relationship to the front crossbeam are not clear.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: The loading route, panel attachment and hand-hoist function are not legible together at the gameplay camera.

material_response.evidence: Timber, enamel and galvanized sheets separate under the production lighting.

surface_variation.evidence: The close capture shows broad variation in the roof sheets and timber, with small details lost at settlement distance.

thickness.evidence: The roof sheets, timber members and enamel panels show layered thickness in the close capture.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The close view is a coherent stylized game asset, but it does not read as a realistic depot matching the approved craft target.

photo_character.evidence: The ArtBrief has no photographic source requirement or reference image.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: For the next target-preserving attempt, remove intermediate front supports, enlarge the side appliance panels, replace the circular hoist shapes with a simple readable rope block and plain hook, and check the same 64-inch gameplay camera before polishing small details.
